title: Past Simple
sub: 過去簡單式：過去「已完成」的動作與狀態；規則動詞加 -ed、不規則要背；否定與問句用 did。

tl.cap: One completed action, fully in the past — the moment is closed.

form.p: 主詞 + 動詞過去式（規則 -ed / 不規則）
ex: 問句: Did + 主詞 + 原形?

uses.d: 常配 yesterday, last week, in 2019, ago。
一般加 -ed；e 結尾加 d；短母音單子音重複；子音+y→ied。
did 已表過去，主動詞回原形。

uses.t: 問句 Did + 主詞 + 原形

mistakes.no: I goed home early.
mistakes.why: go 是不規則，過去式是 went。

mistakes.no: She didn't went to school.
mistakes.why: 有 didn't，動詞回原形 go。

mistakes.no: Did you saw the movie?
mistakes.why: 有 did，動詞回原形 see。

mistakes.no: I finished it yesterday night.
mistakes.why: yesterday night 不自然，用 last night。

tip: 規則動詞加 -ed、不規則要背；否定與問句用 did + 原形（did 已表過去，主動詞回原形）。

q.q: We ___ to the beach last Sunday.
q.why: go 過去式 went。

q.q: She ___ her homework last night.
q.why: do 過去式 did。

q.q: I ___ see him at the party.
q.why: 過去否定 didn't + 原形。

q.q: ___ you enjoy the concert?
q.why: 過去一般動詞問句用 Did。

q.q: He ___ a new car two weeks ago.
q.why: buy 過去式 bought。

q.q: They ___ (study) all weekend.
q.why: study → studied。

q.sent: Did she went to the party ?
q.why: 有 did，動詞回原形 go。

q.sent: I didn't watch TV yesterday
q.why: didn't + 原形。

title: Past Continuous
sub: 過去進行式 was/were + V-ing：過去某個時間點正在進行的動作，常和過去簡單式（打斷）並用。

tl.cap: An action already in progress at a moment in the past — often interrupted by a shorter one.

form.p: 主詞 + was/were + V-ing

uses.d: 配 at 8 p.m. yesterday, this time yesterday。

ex.s: This time yesterday I was flying to Tokyo.

uses.d: was/were V-ing + when + 過去簡單式。

ex.s: I was sleeping when the phone rang.
The sun was shining and birds were singing.

mistakes.no: I was read a book.
mistakes.why: was 後面要用 V-ing。

mistakes.no: They was playing.
mistakes.why: they 複數配 were。

mistakes.no: When it rained, I was walk home.
mistakes.yes: When it started to rain, I was walking home.
mistakes.why: was 後要 V-ing。

tip: was/were + V-ing＝過去某時正在進行；被某事打斷用「was/were V-ing + when + 過去簡單式」；同時進行用 while。

q.q: At 7 last night, we ___ dinner.
q.why: 過去某時正在進行 → were having。

q.q: I ___ a shower when the doorbell rang.
q.why: 被打斷的動作用過去進行 was taking。

q.q: They ___ TV while I ___ dinner.
q.why: 兩個同時進行用 while + 過去進行。

q.q: She ___ loudly during the film.
q.why: she → was + V-ing。

q.q: What ___ you doing at noon?
q.why: you → were + V-ing。

q.q: The kids ___ (play) outside when it started to rain.
q.why: kids → were playing。

q.sent: He was watch TV all evening .
q.why: was 後要用 V-ing → watching。

q.sent: I was studying when you called
q.why: 過去進行 + when + 過去簡單式。

title: Present Perfect Simple
sub: 現在完成式 have/has + 過去分詞：連接過去與現在——經驗、持續到現在、剛完成的結果。

tl.cap: An action or experience in an open period that reaches up to now.

form.p: 主詞 + have/has + 過去分詞

uses.d: 到目前為止的人生經驗。
最近完成、對現在有影響。

uses.t: 不與明確過去時間連用
uses.d: 有 yesterday, last week 等要改用過去式。

ex.s: ✗ I have seen it yesterday → ✓ I saw it yesterday.

mistakes.no: I have saw that movie.
mistakes.why: have 後面用過去分詞 seen。

mistakes.no: She have finished.
mistakes.why: she → has。

mistakes.no: I have finished it yesterday.
mistakes.why: 明確過去時間用過去簡單式。

mistakes.no: Have you went there?
mistakes.why: 過去分詞是 gone。

tip: have/has + 過去分詞；表經驗（ever）、持續（for/since）、剛完成（just/already/yet）；不和 yesterday 等明確過去時間連用。

q.q: I ___ this book three times.
q.why: 到目前的經驗 → have read。

q.q: She ___ already left.
q.why: she → has。

q.q: Have you ___ sushi before?
q.why: 過去分詞 eaten。

q.q: We ___ here since 2019.
q.why: 持續到現在 since → have lived。

q.q: Which is correct?
q.why: 明確過去時間 yesterday 用過去式。

q.q: He ___ (just, finish) his homework.
q.why: has just finished。

q.sent: She has wrote three letters today .
q.why: have/has 後用過去分詞 written。

q.sent: I have never been abroad
q.why: 經驗 have + never + 過去分詞。

title: Present Perfect Continuous
sub: 現在完成進行式 have/has been + V-ing：從過去持續到現在、而且還在進行，強調「持續多久」。

tl.cap: An action continuing from the past right up to now — the focus is on how long.

form.p: 主詞 + have/has been + V-ing
ex: I have been studying for two hours.

uses.t: 從過去持續到現在、仍在進行

ex.s: You're out of breath — have you been running?

uses.d: 進行式重「過程」、完成式重「結果」。

ex.s: I've been painting.（過程）vs I've painted the room.（完成）

uses.d: know, like 等用現在完成式。

ex.s: ✗ I've been knowing → ✓ I've known him for years.

mistakes.no: I have been study for hours.
mistakes.yes: I have been studying for hours.
mistakes.why: been 後面要用 V-ing。

mistakes.no: She has been work here since May.
mistakes.yes: She has been working here since May.
mistakes.why: been 後要 V-ing。

mistakes.no: I have been knowing him for years.
mistakes.yes: I have known him for years.
mistakes.why: know 是狀態動詞，用現在完成式。

tip: have/has been + V-ing＝從過去持續到現在、還在進行，強調「持續多久」；狀態動詞（know, like）不用進行式。

q.q: I ___ for you for an hour!
q.why: 強調持續 → have been waiting。

q.q: It ___ all morning.
q.why: 持續整個早上 → has been raining。

q.q: How long have you ___ Chinese?
q.why: been + V-ing → been studying。

q.q: You look tired. ___ you been working hard?
q.why: you → Have you been…。

q.q: Which uses a stative verb correctly?
q.why: 狀態動詞 want 用完成式。

q.q: She ___ (work) here since 2018.
q.why: has been working since…。

q.sent: They have been play for hours .
q.why: been 後要用 V-ing → playing。

q.sent: We have been waiting for ages
q.why: have been + V-ing + for。

title: Past Perfect
sub: 過去完成式 had + 過去分詞：「過去的過去」——在過去某動作之前就已經完成的動作。

tl.cap: Two past events — the earlier one takes had + past participle.

form.p: 主詞 + had + 過去分詞

uses.d: 兩個過去動作，先發生的用過去完成式。

ex.s: The train had left when we got there.

uses.d: 到過去某時間點已完成。

ex.s: It was my first flight; I had never flown before.

mistakes.no: When I arrived, she had leave.
mistakes.yes: When I arrived, she had left.
mistakes.why: had 後面用過去分詞 left。

mistakes.no: I had saw him before.
mistakes.why: 過去分詞是 seen。

mistakes.no: After I had ate, I went out.
mistakes.yes: After I had eaten, I went out.
mistakes.why: eat 的過去分詞是 eaten。

tip: had + 過去分詞＝「過去的過去」，在另一個過去動作之前就完成；常和 by、before、after 一起用。

q.q: When we got to the station, the train ___.
q.why: 先走（過去的過去）→ had left。

q.q: By the time she arrived, we ___ dinner.
q.why: by the time + 過去，之前已完成 → had finished。

q.q: I ___ never ___ a kangaroo before that trip.
q.why: 過去之前的經驗 → had seen。

q.q: He realized he ___ his keys at home.
q.why: realize（過去）之前已發生 → had left。

q.q: After they ___ lunch, they went for a walk.
q.why: after + 過去完成 had had。

q.q: She ___ (already, leave) when I called.
q.why: had already left。

q.sent: When I woke up , it had stop raining .
q.why: had 後用過去分詞 stopped。

q.sent: The movie had started before we arrived
q.why: 過去完成 + before + 過去簡單式。

title: Past Perfect Continuous
sub: 過去完成進行式 had been + V-ing：在過去某時間點之前，已持續進行了一段時間的動作。

tl.cap: A longer action that had been continuing up to a later point in the past.

form.p: 主詞 + had been + V-ing
ex: She was tired because she had been working all day.
I had been waiting for an hour when the bus came.

uses.t: 過去某點之前持續的動作

ex.s: They had been driving for hours before they stopped.
His eyes were red; he had been crying.
I had been waiting ten minutes when she arrived.

mistakes.no: I had been wait for ages.
mistakes.yes: I had been waiting for ages.
mistakes.why: been 後面用 V-ing。

mistakes.no: They had been play soccer.
mistakes.why: been 後要 V-ing。

mistakes.no: She had been know him for years.
mistakes.yes: She had known him for years.
mistakes.why: know 是狀態動詞。

tip: had been + V-ing＝過去某時間點之前已持續進行一段時間；常用來解釋過去的結果（累、濕、紅眼…）。

q.q: He was exhausted because he ___ all night.
q.why: 解釋過去結果 → had been working。

q.q: They ___ for an hour when it finally stopped raining.
q.why: 過去之前持續 → had been waiting。

q.q: The ground was wet; it ___.
q.why: 由結果推過去持續 → had been raining。

q.q: How long ___ you been studying before the test?
q.why: 過去完成進行用 had been。

q.q: She ___ been feeling sick for days before she saw a doctor.
q.why: 過去的過去持續 → had been。

q.q: We ___ (drive) for hours before we found a hotel.
q.why: had been driving。

q.sent: I had been wait outside for ages .
q.why: been 後用 V-ing → waiting。

q.sent: She had been crying before I came
q.why: had been + V-ing + before + 過去簡單式。

title: Used To
sub: used to + 原形：過去的習慣或狀態（現在已不再如此）；否定 didn't use to、問句 Did…use to?

form.p: 主詞 + used to + 原形動詞
ex: 問句: Did you use to…?

ex.s: There used to be a shop here.

uses.t: 別和 be used to 混
uses.d: be used to + V-ing＝習慣於（不同！）。

ex.s: I'm used to getting up early.（習慣於）

mistakes.no: I use to play the guitar.
mistakes.yes: I used to play the guitar.
mistakes.why: 肯定要有 d：used to。

mistakes.no: I didn't used to smoke.
mistakes.why: 否定去掉 d：didn't use to。

mistakes.no: She used to playing tennis.
mistakes.why: used to 後接原形。

tip: used to + 原形＝過去的習慣／狀態（現在不再）；否定與問句用 use to（去掉 d）：didn't use to / Did you use to…?

q.q: I ___ live in the countryside.
q.why: 肯定用 used to + 原形。

q.q: She ___ like vegetables, but now she loves them.
q.why: 否定去 d → didn't use to。

q.q: ___ you use to play any instrument?
q.why: 問句 Did … use to…？

q.q: There ___ be a cinema here.
q.why: 過去狀態 used to。

q.q: He used to ___ very shy.
q.why: used to + 原形 be。

q.q: We ___ (use to, 否定) have a car.
q.why: didn't use to have。

q.sent: I use to collect stamps as a kid .
q.why: 肯定要有 d：used to。

q.sent: She used to have long hair
q.why: used to + 原形。

zh: 過去時間詞 ago / last / yesterday
title: Past Time Words
sub: 過去時間詞 ago / last / yesterday / in + 年：和過去簡單式搭配，以及它們的位置與常見錯誤。

form.p: 過去簡單式 + 過去時間詞

uses.d: last night, last week, last year（不加 the）。
昨天；the day before yesterday 前天。
這些時間詞出現就用過去式。

mistakes.no: I saw him before two days.
mistakes.yes: I saw him two days ago.
mistakes.why: 「…以前」用 ago，放時間後面。

mistakes.no: I went there yesterday night.
mistakes.why: 昨晚是 last night。

mistakes.no: We met last the week.
mistakes.why: last week 不加 the。

tip: ago 放在時間「後面」（two days ago）；last/yesterday 前不加 the、不加介系詞；這些時間詞都配過去簡單式。

q.q: I finished the book two days ___.
q.why: 「…以前」用 ago。

q.q: We had a test ___ week.
q.why: last week（不加 the）。

q.q: She called me ___.
q.why: 昨晚 → last night。

q.q: He was born ___ 2010.
q.why: 年份用 in。

q.q: They left an hour ___.
q.why: an hour ago。

q.q: I visited Japan three years ___.
q.why: three years ago。

q.sent: We met before three months .
q.why: 「…以前」用 ago，放時間後。

q.sent: She moved here last year
q.why: 過去簡單式 + last year。

title: Stative Verbs
sub: 狀態動詞（know, like, want, have擁有, believe…）表「狀態」而非動作，通常不用進行式。

form.p: 狀態動詞用簡單式，不用 be + V-ing

uses.d: know, think, believe, understand, mean, agree。
like, love, hate, want, need, prefer。
動作意義時可用進行式。

ex.s: I have a car.（擁有）vs I'm having lunch.（動作）
I think so.（認為）vs I'm thinking about it.（正在想）

mistakes.no: I am knowing the answer.
mistakes.why: know 是狀態動詞，用簡單式。

mistakes.no: She is wanting a new phone.
mistakes.why: want 是狀態動詞。

mistakes.no: I am having a bike.
mistakes.why: have 表擁有時不用進行式。

tip: 狀態動詞（know, like, want, have擁有, believe）用簡單式，不用進行式；有些字兩用（I'm having lunch 是動作、I have a car 是擁有）。

q.q: I ___ what you mean.
q.why: understand 狀態動詞用簡單式。

q.q: She ___ chocolate ice cream.
q.why: love 是狀態動詞。

q.q: This box ___ ten books.
q.why: contain 狀態動詞。

q.q: Which is correct?
q.why: want 用簡單式。

q.q: Right now I ___ lunch.
q.why: have 表動作（吃午餐）可用進行式。

q.q: I ___ (not, believe) you! （狀態動詞）
q.why: believe 狀態動詞 → don't believe。

q.sent: She is knowing the answer .
q.why: know 狀態動詞用簡單式 knows。

q.sent: This perfume smells really nice
q.why: 感官狀態動詞 smell 用簡單式。

title: Present Perfect: For & Since
sub: 現在完成式的 for 和 since：for + 一段時間（持續多久）、since + 時間點（從何時開始）。

form.p: have/has + 過去分詞 + for 一段時間　/　since 時間點

ex.s: for two hours / a week / a long time

uses.d: since 後可接一個過去的事件。

mistakes.no: I have lived here since five years.
mistakes.yes: I have lived here for five years.
mistakes.why: 一段時間長度用 for。

mistakes.no: She has worked here for 2020.
mistakes.why: 時間點／起點用 since。

mistakes.no: I haven't seen him since three days.
mistakes.yes: I haven't seen him for three days.
mistakes.why: 一段時間長度用 for。

tip: for + 一段時間長度（for 3 years）、since + 時間點／起點（since 2020）；兩者常配現在完成式回答 How long…?

q.q: I've known her ___ ten years.
q.why: ten years 是時間長度 → for。

q.q: They've lived here ___ 2015.
q.why: 2015 是時間點 → since。

q.q: We haven't met ___ last Christmas.
q.why: last Christmas 是起點 → since。

q.q: She has been studying ___ three hours.
q.why: three hours 是長度 → for。

q.q: How long ___ you worked here?
q.why: How long + 現在完成 → have。

q.q: I've been awake ___ (for/since) 5 a.m.
q.why: 5 a.m. 是時間點 → since。

q.sent: He has worked here since ten years .
q.why: ten years 是長度 → for。

q.sent: We have been friends for years
q.why: for + 一段時間。

zh: 未來式 be going to / will
title: Future: Going To vs Will
sub: 未來式 will 和 be going to：will 多用於臨時決定、預測與承諾；be going to 用於事先的計畫與有跡象的預測。

tl.cap: Both point forward — the difference is when you decided.

form.p: will + 原形　/　be going to + 原形
ex: Look at the clouds — it's going to rain.

uses.d: 對未來的看法（I think / probably）。

uses.t: be going to：有跡象的預測

mistakes.no: I will to call you later.
mistakes.why: will 後面直接接原形，不加 to。

mistakes.no: She wills come tomorrow.
mistakes.why: will 沒有人稱變化。

mistakes.no: I will going to travel.
mistakes.why: will 和 be going to 不能混用。

mistakes.no: Look! It will rain.
mistakes.why: 眼前有跡象的預測用 be going to。

tip: 臨時決定、承諾、單純預測用 will；事先的計畫、眼前有跡象的預測用 be going to。will / going to 後面都接原形。

q.q: "The bag looks heavy." "I ___ carry it for you."
q.why: 當下才決定幫忙 → will。

q.q: We've bought the tickets. We ___ visit Japan in July.
q.why: 事先計畫好 → be going to。

q.q: Look at those black clouds! It ___ rain.
q.why: 眼前有跡象 → be going to。

q.q: ___ you help me move this table?
q.why: 請求用 Will you…?

q.q: I think our team ___ win the match.
q.why: 單純預測（I think）→ will。

q.q: Don't worry, I ___ (help) you with it.
q.why: 當下決定 → will help。

q.sent: She will to join us tonight .
q.why: will 後直接接原形，去掉 to。

q.sent: I'm going to learn French
q.why: 打算／計畫 → be going to + 原形。

zh: 未來進行式與未來完成式
title: Future Continuous & Perfect
sub: 未來進行式 will be V-ing（未來某時正在進行）與未來完成式 will have + 過去分詞（未來某時之前已完成）。

form.p: will be + V-ing　/　will have + 過去分詞
ex: This time tomorrow I will be flying.

uses.t: 未來進行式：未來某時正在進行
uses.d: 配 at / this time + 未來時間。

ex.s: At 9 tonight we will be watching the game.

uses.t: 未來進行式：禮貌詢問計畫
未來完成式：未來某時之前完成
uses.d: 配 by + 未來時間 / by the time。

ex.s: By Friday, she will have finished the report.

uses.t: 未來完成式：到未來某時的成果

uses.d: 進行＝那時正在做；完成＝那時之前已做完。

ex.s: At 5 I'll be cooking. By 6 I'll have cooked dinner.

mistakes.no: This time tomorrow I will fly to Paris.
mistakes.yes: This time tomorrow I will be flying to Paris.
mistakes.why: 未來某時正在進行用 will be + V-ing。

mistakes.no: By next year I will finish my degree.
mistakes.yes: By next year I will have finished my degree.
mistakes.why: 未來某時之前完成用 will have + 過去分詞。

mistakes.no: By June she will have graduate.
mistakes.yes: By June she will have graduated.
mistakes.why: will have 後面用過去分詞。

tip: will be + V-ing＝未來某時「正在進行」；will have + 過去分詞＝未來某時「之前已完成」（常配 by + 未來時間）。

q.q: At 8 p.m. tomorrow, I ___ dinner with my family.
q.why: 未來某時正在進行 → will be having。

q.q: By the time you arrive, the film ___.
q.why: 你到之前已開始 → will have started。

q.q: This time next week she ___ on a beach in Bali.
q.why: 未來某時正在進行 → will be relaxing。

q.q: By 2035, scientists ___ a cure, many hope.
q.why: 未來某時之前完成 → will have found。

q.q: ___ you ___ the printer this afternoon? I need it.
q.why: 禮貌問未來安排 → Will you be using…?

q.q: By Friday I ___ (finish) all my exams.
q.why: 未來之前完成 → will have finished。

q.sent: By midnight they will have arrive home .
q.why: will have 後用過去分詞 arrived。

q.sent: This time tomorrow I'll be sleeping
q.why: 未來某時正在進行 → will be + V-ing。

title: Future Perfect Continuous
sub: 未來完成進行式 will have been + V-ing：到未來某時間點為止、已持續進行一段時間的動作，強調「持續多久」。

tl.cap: An action continuing up to a point in the future — the focus is on the duration by then.

form.p: will have been + V-ing
ex: By June, I will have been studying here for two years.
By 5 p.m. he will have been working for ten hours.

uses.t: 到未來某時為止已持續多久
uses.d: 配 by + 未來時間 + for。

ex.s: By next month, we will have been living here for a year.
She'll be tired — she will have been driving all day.

uses.d: 問到那時為止做了多久。

ex.s: ✗ will have been knowing → ✓ will have known

mistakes.no: By June I will have been study for two years.
mistakes.yes: By June I will have been studying for two years.
mistakes.why: been 後面用 V-ing。

mistakes.no: By then she will have been worked here for a decade.
mistakes.yes: By then she will have been working here for a decade.
mistakes.why: been 後要 V-ing。

mistakes.no: By 2030 I will have been knowing him for years.
mistakes.yes: By 2030 I will have known him for years.
mistakes.why: know 是狀態動詞，用未來完成式。

tip: will have been + V-ing＝到未來某時間點為止已持續進行一段時間（常配 by + 未來時間 + for）；狀態動詞不用進行式。

q.q: By December, I ___ English for five years.
q.why: 到未來某時為止持續 → will have been studying。

q.q: At 6 p.m. the team ___ for eight hours straight.
q.why: 到那時為止持續 → will have been working。

q.q: How long ___ you ___ been waiting by the time I get there?
q.why: 未來完成進行 → will have been。

q.q: Which is correct?
opts: By then I will have been knowing her.
By then I will have known her for years.
I will have been know her.
She will have been owned it.
q.why: 狀態動詞 know 用未來完成式。

q.q: By next week we ___ (travel) for a month.
q.why: will have been travelling。

q.sent: By noon he will have been drive for six hours .
q.why: been 後用 V-ing → driving。

title: Zero Conditional
sub: 零條件句 If + 現在簡單式, 現在簡單式：表示「永遠成立」的事實、科學定律與習慣。

form.p: If + 現在簡單式, 主詞 + 現在簡單式
ex: When I'm tired, I go to bed early.

ex.s: If you mix blue and yellow, you get green.
If you press this, the light turns on.

mistakes.no: If you will heat ice, it melts.
mistakes.yes: If you heat ice, it melts.
mistakes.why: 零條件句 if 子句用現在式，不用 will。

mistakes.no: If water boils, it will turn to steam.
mistakes.yes: If water boils, it turns to steam.
mistakes.why: 永遠成立的事實，主句也用現在式。

mistakes.no: If it rains, the ground got wet.
mistakes.yes: If it rains, the ground gets wet.
mistakes.why: 零條件句兩邊都用現在式。

tip: 零條件句＝永遠成立的事實／習慣：If + 現在簡單式, 現在簡單式；兩邊都不用 will，If 常可換成 When。

q.q: If you ___ water to 100°C, it ___.
q.why: 零條件句兩邊用現在式。

q.q: If I ___ hungry, I eat a snack.
q.why: if 子句用現在式 am。

q.q: Plants die if you ___ them.
q.why: 現在式否定 don't water。

q.q: Which is a correct zero conditional?
opts: If it rains, the match will stop.
If you drop it, it breaks.
If you will study, you pass.
If I was rich, I'd travel.
q.why: 永遠成立 → 兩邊現在式。

q.q: ___ you press this button, the machine starts.
q.why: 條件用 If（≈ When）。

q.q: If you mix red and white, you ___ (get) pink.
q.why: 事實 → 現在式 get。

q.sent: If the sun sets , it will get dark .
q.why: 零條件句主句用現在式 → it gets dark。

q.sent: Ice melts if you heat it
q.why: 零條件句可把主句放前面。

title: First Conditional
sub: 第一條件句 If + 現在簡單式, will + 原形：表示未來「可能發生」的情況與其結果。

form.p: If + 現在簡單式, 主詞 + will + 原形

ex.s: If I have time, I will call you.

uses.d: 重點：if 子句裡不用 will！

uses.t: 主句可用 will / can / may / 祈使句

ex.s: If you finish, you can go. / If you see him, tell him.
Unless you leave now, you'll miss it.

uses.d: 主句放前面時逗號省略。

mistakes.no: If it will rain, I will stay home.
mistakes.yes: If it rains, I will stay home.
mistakes.why: 第一條件句 if 子句用現在式，不用 will。

mistakes.no: If you study hard, you will passed.
mistakes.yes: If you study hard, you will pass.
mistakes.why: will 後面接原形 pass。

mistakes.no: Unless you don't hurry, you'll be late.
mistakes.yes: Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
mistakes.why: unless 已含否定，不再加 not。

tip: 第一條件句＝未來可能發生：If + 現在簡單式, will + 原形；if 子句絕不用 will；unless = if…not。

q.q: If it ___ tomorrow, we ___ the picnic.
q.why: if 子句現在式 + 主句 will。

q.q: If you ___ hard, you'll pass the exam.
q.why: if 子句用現在式 study。

q.q: We'll miss the train ___ we leave now.
q.why: 除非現在走否則會錯過 → unless。

q.q: If she calls, ___ her I'm out.
q.why: 主句可用祈使句 tell。

q.q: Which is correct?
opts: If I will see him, I'll say hi.
If I see him, I'll say hi.
If I see him, I say hi tomorrow.
If I saw him, I'll say hi.
q.why: if 現在式 + 主句 will。

q.q: If you ___ (not hurry), we'll be late.
q.why: if 子句現在式否定 don't hurry。

q.sent: If the weather will be nice , we'll go hiking .
q.why: if 子句用現在式 → the weather is nice。

q.sent: I'll help you if you ask
q.why: 第一條件句可倒裝，主句在前。

zh: 用現在進行式談未來安排
title: Future: Present Continuous
sub: 表達未來安排：現在進行式（已排定的約會）、be going to（打算）、現在簡單式（時刻表）。

form.p: be + V-ing（已安排）／ be going to（打算）／ 現在簡單式（時刻表）
ex: I'm meeting Tom at six.（已約好）
I'm going to learn French.（打算）

uses.t: 現在進行式：已排定的約會
uses.d: 已經和別人約好、定了時間地點。

ex.s: We're having dinner with Grandma tonight.

uses.d: 心裡決定了但不一定排定細節。

ex.s: I'm going to start a diet.

uses.t: 現在簡單式：時刻表／班表

uses.d: 已約定→進行式；打算→going to；時刻表→簡單式。

ex.s: I'm seeing the doctor at 3.（已約）

mistakes.no: I meet Tom tomorrow at six.
mistakes.yes: I'm meeting Tom tomorrow at six.
mistakes.why: 已經約好的安排用現在進行式。

mistakes.no: The train is leaving at 9 every day.
mistakes.yes: The train leaves at 9 every day.
mistakes.why: 時刻表用現在簡單式。

mistakes.no: I'm going to meeting them.
mistakes.why: be going to 後接原形。

tip: 已和人約好的安排用現在進行式（I'm meeting…）、打算用 be going to、時刻表／班表用現在簡單式。

q.q: I ___ the dentist at 3 tomorrow. (already booked)
q.why: 已預約的安排用現在進行式。

q.q: The plane ___ at 10:45. (timetable)
q.why: 時刻表用現在簡單式。

q.q: I've decided — I ___ quit smoking.
q.why: 打算 → be going to。

q.q: What ___ you ___ this weekend? (your plans with friends)
q.why: 已安排的計畫用現在進行式問。

q.q: Hurry! The show ___ in five minutes.
q.why: 固定場次時間 → 現在簡單式 starts。

q.q: We ___ (have) a party on Saturday — you're invited!
q.why: 已安排 → are having。

q.sent: She is flying to Rome ; the flight is leaving at dawn .
q.why: 班機時刻表用現在簡單式 → leaves。

q.sent: I'm meeting my friends tonight
q.why: 已約定的安排用現在進行式。

title: Tenses Review
sub: 時態總複習：用時間詞與語境判斷該用哪個時態——過去、現在、未來與完成式的綜合運用。

form.p: 看「時間詞」與「語境」選時態
ex: now / at the moment → 進行

uses.d: 每個時態都有常配的時間詞。

uses.t: 過去 vs 現在完成
uses.d: 明確過去時間用過去式；連接到現在用完成式。

ex.s: I saw it yesterday. / I have seen it (經驗).

uses.d: 正在／暫時用進行；習慣／事實用簡單。

ex.s: I usually walk, but today I'm taking the bus.

uses.d: 臨時 will／計畫 going to／已約定進行式。

ex.s: I'll get it. / I'm going to study. / I'm meeting Tom.

uses.d: have／had／will have + 過去分詞＝到某時為止。

ex.s: 現在完成 / 過去完成 / 未來完成

mistakes.no: I have seen him yesterday.
mistakes.why: 明確過去時間 yesterday 用過去式。

mistakes.no: I am knowing the answer.
mistakes.why: 狀態動詞用簡單式。

mistakes.no: When I arrived, she already left.
mistakes.yes: When I arrived, she had already left.
mistakes.why: 過去的過去用過去完成式。

mistakes.no: Look! It will rain.
mistakes.why: 眼前有跡象的預測用 be going to。

tip: 先找時間詞：yesterday→過去、now→進行、for/since/already→完成、tomorrow→未來；再看是習慣、事實、暫時還是計畫。

q.q: I ___ my keys. I can't find them now.
q.why: 過去動作、結果影響現在 → 現在完成 have lost。

q.q: Last summer we ___ to Kenting.
q.why: 明確過去時間 last summer → 過去式 went。

q.q: Listen! Someone ___ the piano.
q.why: 此刻正在發生 → 現在進行 is playing。

q.q: By the time we got home, the storm ___.
q.why: 過去的過去 → had passed。

q.q: I ___ here since 2018.
q.why: since → 現在完成 have worked。

q.q: Water ___ at 100°C.
q.why: 科學事實 → 現在簡單式 boils。

q.q: I ___ (not see) her since last week.
q.why: since → 現在完成否定 haven't seen。

q.sent: She has arrived home two hours ago .
q.why: 有 ago（明確過去）用過去式 → She arrived。

title: Comparatives & Superlatives
sub: 比較級（-er / more）比較兩者、最高級（the -est / the most）比較三者以上；短形容詞加字尾、長形容詞用 more/most，另有不規則字。

form.p: 比較級 + than　/　the + 最高級

uses.t: 比較級 + than；最高級 + the

mistakes.no: She is more taller than me.
mistakes.why: -er 和 more 不能同時用（雙重比較）。

mistakes.no: He is the most tall boy.
mistakes.why: 短形容詞用 -est，不用 most。

mistakes.no: This book is gooder.
mistakes.why: good 的比較級是不規則 better。

mistakes.no: It is the better of the three.
mistakes.yes: It is the best of the three.
mistakes.why: 三者以上用最高級 best。

tip: 兩者比較用比較級 + than，三者以上用 the + 最高級；短字加 -er/-est、長字用 more/most，good/bad 等不規則要背；別把 more 和 -er 疊用。

q.q: A train is ___ than a bus.
q.why: 兩者比較用比較級 faster。

q.q: Mount Everest is the ___ mountain in the world.
q.why: 最高級 the highest。

q.q: This question is ___ than the last one.
q.why: 長形容詞用 more difficult。

q.q: My grades are ___ than before.
q.why: good 的比較級是 better。

q.q: Today is the ___ day of my life!
q.why: happy → happiest（y改i）。

q.q: A car is ___ (big) than a bike.
q.why: big → bigger。

q.sent: She is the most smartest student .
q.why: most 和 -est 不能疊用 → the smartest。

q.sent: He is the best player here
q.why: 最高級 the + best。

title: Quantifiers: Some & Any
sub: some 用於肯定句與邀請／請求；any 用於否定句與一般疑問句；兩者都接可數複數或不可數名詞。

form.p: some（肯定）　/　any（否定、疑問）+ 名詞

ex.s: There are some apples on the table.
I need something to eat. / Is there anyone home?

mistakes.no: I don't have some time.
mistakes.why: 否定句用 any。

mistakes.no: Do you have some questions?
mistakes.why: 一般疑問句用 any。

mistakes.no: I have any friends here.
mistakes.why: 肯定句用 some。

mistakes.no: I didn't see anybody... I saw nobody and I didn't see nobody.
mistakes.why: 否定句搭 anybody，不用雙重否定。

tip: 肯定句用 some，否定句和一般疑問句用 any；但邀請或請求（Would you like…? Can I have…?）仍用 some。複合字 some-/any- 規則相同。

q.q: There are ___ cookies in the jar.
q.why: 肯定句用 some。

q.q: I don't have ___ cash on me.
q.why: 否定句用 any。

q.q: Are there ___ seats left?
q.why: 一般疑問句用 any。

q.q: Would you like ___ more coffee?
q.why: 邀請用 some。

q.q: Is there ___ I can help you with?
q.why: 疑問用 anything。

q.q: We need ___ (some/any) help — we can't do it alone.
q.why: 肯定句用 some。

q.sent: She didn't buy some milk today .
q.why: 否定句用 any → didn't buy any milk。

q.sent: Do you have any pets
q.why: 一般疑問句用 any。

title: Linking Words
sub: 基本連接詞 and（並列）、but（轉折）、or（選擇）、so（結果）、because（原因）把兩個想法連成一句。

form.p: 句子 + 連接詞 + 句子

ex.s: It was raining, so we stayed in.
I was late because the bus was slow.

mistakes.no: It was late, so because I went home.
mistakes.yes: It was late, so I went home.
mistakes.why: so 和 because 擇一，不能同時用。

mistakes.no: Because I was tired. I went to bed.
mistakes.yes: Because I was tired, I went to bed.
mistakes.why: because 子句接主句，用逗號不用句點。

mistakes.no: I was sick, because I stayed home.
mistakes.yes: I stayed home because I was sick.
mistakes.why: because 要接「原因」，順序別顛倒。

tip: and 並列、but 轉折、or 選擇、so 表結果、because 表原因；so 和 because 不能在同一句一起用，一個表結果、一個表原因。

q.q: I wanted to go out, ___ it was raining.
q.why: 前後相反，用 but。

q.q: She was hungry, ___ she made a sandwich.
q.why: 結果用 so。

q.q: We stayed inside ___ it was cold.
q.why: 原因用 because。

q.q: Would you like tea ___ coffee?
q.why: 選擇用 or。

q.q: He is kind ___ helpful.
q.why: 並列相似特質用 and。

q.q: I was tired, ___ (結果) I went to bed early.
q.why: 表結果用 so。

q.sent: It was late , so because we left .
q.why: so 和 because 不能同時用；去掉 because → so we left。

q.sent: I stayed home because I was sick
q.why: because 接原因子句。

title: As … As Comparisons
sub: as + 形容詞／副詞 + as 表示「和…一樣」；否定 not as/so…as 表示「不如…」。

form.p: as + 形容詞／副詞（原級）+ as
ex: She is as tall as her brother.

ex.s: This bag is as big as that one.

mistakes.no: She is as taller as him.
mistakes.yes: She is as tall as him.
mistakes.why: as…as 中間用原級，不用比較級。

mistakes.no: It's as big than that.
mistakes.why: 同級比較兩邊都用 as。

mistakes.no: I'm not so tall than you.
mistakes.yes: I'm not as tall as you.
mistakes.why: 否定用 not as/so … as。

tip: as + 原級 + as＝一樣；中間絕不用比較級或 than；否定 not as/so…as 表示「不如」。

q.q: Anna is ___ her sister. (same height)
q.why: 一樣高 → as tall as。

q.q: Today is ___ yesterday. (today is colder-less)
q.why: 不如昨天冷 → not as cold as。

q.q: He has ___ money ___ his boss.
q.why: 不可數 money → as much as。

q.q: Please reply ___ possible.
q.why: 固定用法 as soon as possible。

q.q: This house is twice ___ big ___ ours.
q.why: 倍數 twice as big as。

q.q: He is ___ strong ___ an ox. （一樣）
q.why: 同級 as strong as。

q.sent: My phone is as new than yours .
q.why: as…as 兩邊都用 as，不用 than。

q.sent: She sings as well as you
q.why: as + 副詞 + as。

title: Too & Enough
sub: too（太…，過頭，含負面）放形容詞前；enough（足夠）放形容詞／副詞後、名詞前；兩者常接 to + 原形。

form.p: too + 形容詞　/　形容詞 + enough　/　enough + 名詞

ex.s: He's too tired to walk. / old enough to vote.

mistakes.no: She is enough old to drive.
mistakes.yes: She is old enough to drive.
mistakes.why: enough 放形容詞「後面」。

mistakes.no: I'm too much tired.
mistakes.why: too 直接加形容詞，不加 much。

mistakes.no: Thank you, you are too kind.
mistakes.yes: Thank you, you are very kind.
mistakes.why: 誇獎用 very；too 帶負面。

tip: too 放形容詞「前」（太…，負面）；enough 放形容詞「後」、名詞「前」（足夠）；兩者接 to + 原形；誇獎用 very 不用 too。

q.q: This soup is ___ salty to eat.
q.why: 過頭、負面 → too salty。

q.q: Are you ___ to carry this box?
q.why: enough 放形容詞後 → strong enough。

q.q: We don't have ___ chairs for everyone.
q.why: enough 放名詞前 → enough chairs。

q.q: He was ___ tired ___ finish the race.
q.why: too…to + 原形。

q.q: Which uses 'too' correctly (negative)?
opts: The box is too heavy to lift.
She sings too well, well done.
q.why: too 表負面（太重搬不動）。

q.q: She isn't ___ (old enough / enough old) to watch this film.
q.why: enough 放形容詞後 → old enough。

q.sent: He is enough tall to play basketball .
q.why: enough 放形容詞後 → tall enough。

q.sent: It's too cold to swim
q.why: too + 形容詞 + to + 原形。

title: Either…or / Neither…nor
sub: either…or（兩者之一）、neither…nor（兩者皆非）、both…and（兩者都）連接對等的兩項。

form.p: either A or B　/　neither A nor B　/　both A and B

ex.s: You can have either cake or ice cream.

uses.d: 本身已含否定，動詞用肯定。
either/neither…的動詞跟靠近的名詞一致。

mistakes.no: Neither Tom or Sam came.
mistakes.why: neither 要配 nor。

mistakes.no: I don't want neither of them.
mistakes.yes: I want neither of them. / I don't want either of them.
mistakes.why: neither 本身否定，不再加 don't（雙重否定）。

mistakes.no: You can take both this or that.
mistakes.yes: You can take both this and that.
mistakes.why: both 要配 and。

tip: 配對固定：either…or（二選一）、neither…nor（都不，動詞用肯定）、both…and（都，動詞複數）；別把 neither 配 or，別和 don't 疊成雙重否定。

q.q: You can pay ___ cash ___ card.
q.why: 二選一 → either…or。

q.q: ___ Anna ___ Ben passed; both failed.
q.why: 都不 → neither…nor。

q.q: ___ my parents ___ I enjoy hiking.
q.why: 兩者都 → both…and。

q.q: "I can't swim." "___"
q.why: 附和否定 → Me neither。

q.q: Neither the teacher nor the students ___ ready.
q.why: 動詞配最近的主詞 students → were。

q.q: She speaks ___ French ___ German — just English. （都不）
q.why: 都不 → neither…nor。

q.sent: I don't like neither of the two options .
q.why: neither 已否定，去掉 don't → I like neither。

q.sent: Both Tom and Mary are coming
q.why: both…and + 複數動詞。

title: Although & However
sub: 表讓步轉折：although／though + 子句、despite／in spite of + 名詞、however（副詞，連接兩句並加標點）。

form.p: Although + 子句, …　/　…; however, …　/　Despite + 名詞

uses.d: 副詞，前面句點或分號，後面逗號。

uses.t: despite / in spite of + 名詞

ex.s: Despite the noise, I slept. / In spite of being tired…
Although it rained, we went.（不加 but）

uses.d: although 子句可放句首或句中。

mistakes.no: Although it was raining, but we went out.
mistakes.yes: Although it was raining, we went out.
mistakes.why: although 和 but 不能同時用。

mistakes.no: Despite of the rain, we played.
mistakes.why: despite 後面不加 of（in spite of 才有 of）。

mistakes.no: However it was late, we stayed.
mistakes.yes: Although it was late, we stayed.
mistakes.why: however 不當從屬連接詞接子句；接子句用 although。

tip: although/though 接子句、despite/in spite of 接名詞、however 連接兩句（前句點後逗號）；although 不與 but 並用；despite 後不加 of。

q.q: ___ it was expensive, she bought it.
q.why: 後接子句 → Although。

q.q: ___ the bad weather, the game continued.
q.why: 後接名詞 → Despite。

q.q: The plan was risky. ___, it worked.
q.why: 連接兩句的副詞 → However,。

q.q: Which sentence is correct?
opts: Although it rained, but we went.
q.why: although 不配 but。

q.q: ___ being tired, he kept working.
q.why: 接 V-ing → Despite / In spite of。

q.q: ___ (Although/Despite) the traffic, we arrived on time.
q.why: the traffic 是名詞 → Despite。

q.sent: Although he was tired , but he finished .
q.why: although 和 but 不能並用，去掉 but。

q.sent: Despite the rain we had fun
q.why: despite + 名詞。

title: Transition Signals
sub: 轉承語讓文章更連貫：添加（also, in addition）、對比（on the other hand）、舉例（for example）、結果（therefore）、結論（in conclusion）。

form.p: 轉承語 + 逗號 + 完整句子

uses.d: however, on the other hand, in contrast。

ex.s: I like tea. On the other hand, he prefers coffee.

uses.d: for example, for instance, such as。
therefore, as a result, thus, so。

ex.s: It rained. As a result, the game stopped.

mistakes.no: For example, like pizza and pasta.
mistakes.yes: For example, I like pizza and pasta.
mistakes.why: 轉承語後要接完整句子。

mistakes.no: However I think it's wrong.
mistakes.why: 句首轉承語後加逗號。

mistakes.no: In addition of this, it's cheap.
mistakes.why: in addition 後直接逗號，不加 of。

tip: 轉承語放句首、後加逗號、再接完整句子；依功能選字：添加(in addition)、對比(however)、舉例(for example)、結果(therefore)、結論(in conclusion)。

q.q: The city is beautiful. ___, it's very expensive.
q.why: 前後對比 → However。

q.q: I love fruit — ___, apples, bananas, and grapes.
q.why: 舉例 → for example。

q.q: He didn't study. ___, he failed the test.
q.why: 結果 → As a result。

q.q: The plan saves time. ___, it saves money.
q.why: 添加訊息 → In addition。

q.q: ___, I believe exercise is essential for health.
q.why: 總結 → In conclusion。

q.q: The food was great. ___ (添加), the service was fast.
q.why: 添加訊息 → In addition / Moreover。

q.sent: However I disagree with the plan .
q.why: 句首轉承語後要加逗號 → However, I。

q.sent: For example I enjoy hiking
q.why: 舉例轉承語後接完整句。
